title.th: คำสั่งตามมาตรา 11(3)

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275)
Order under Section 11 (3)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 30th June 2002:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 31st July 2002, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Arbitration Act (Chapter 10)
2. Children Development Co-Savings Act (Chapter 38A)
3. Civil Service College Act (Chapter 45)
4. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act (Chapter 53B)
5. District Cooling Act (Chapter 84A)
6. Education Service Incentive Payment Act (Chapter 87B)
7. Electricity Act (Chapter 89A)
8. Energy Market Authority of Singapore Act (Chapter 92B)
9. Gas Act (Chapter 116A)
10. Health Promotion Board Act (Chapter 122B)
11. Health Sciences Authority Act (Chapter 122C)
12. Home Affairs Uniformed Services Superannuation Act (Chapter 126B)
13. Intellectual Property Office of Singapore Act (Chapter 140)
14. Lifelong Learning Endowment Fund Act (Chapter 162A)
15. Patents Act (Chapter 221)
16. Public Utilities Act (Chapter 261)
17. Singapore Business Federation Act (Chapter 297A)
18. Singapore Land Authority Act (Chapter 301)
19. United Nations Act (Chapter 339)
